capabilities: Open notes in reader mode by default
Switch to edit mode on a single or double click
Place the cursor at the bottom, top, or click position
Toggle back to reader mode with double clicks
Ignore clicks on links, tags, checkboxes and fold buttons
extras: Disable on mobile is on by default; existing settings are kept when upgrading, and a missing setting means the installed version is out of date.
motivation: The author wanted notes to feel more like a wiki, where a note is read first and edited with a single click.
problem: Notes open in edit mode, so reading requires switching views manually and then clicking into the text to type.
summary: Plugin that opens every note in reader mode and switches to edit mode on a click, placing the cursor where you choose.
